metadata.title: Higher Holonomy for Higher Lie Algebroid Connections on Graded Vector Bundles
metadata.abstract: We prove the existence of a Riemann--Hilbert $A_\infty$-functor from the curved dg-category of $\mathscr{A}$-connections on graded vector bundles, where $\mathscr{A}$ is a higher Lie algebroid, to the curved dg-category of $\Pi_\infty(\mathscr{A})$-connections on graded vector bundles, where $\Pi_\infty(\mathscr{A})$ is the homotopy groupoid of $\mathscr{A}$. When restricted to the sub dg-categories of flat objects, it induces an $A_\infty$-functor from the dg-category of representations up to homotopy of $\mathscr{A}$ to the dg-category of representations up to homotopy of $\Pi_\infty(\mathscr{A})$, which recovers the one from arXiv:1011.4693 and arXiv:0908.2843 when $\mathscr{A}$ is a Lie algebroid. The key ingredient for defining such functors is a non-abelian Stokes's theorem for endomorphism-valued differential forms. Furthermore, for a graded vector bundle $E$, we introduce the notion of its higher general linear groupoid in such a way that $G$-connections on $E$, for a higher Lie groupoid $G$, become smooth functors from $G$ to the higher general linear groupoid of $E$. We combine this with the Riemann--Hilbert functor to define higher parallel transport functors for $\mathscr{A}$-connections. Finally, we use these functors to define the higher holonomy groups of $\mathscr{A}$-connections and endow them with the structure of augmented simplicial Lie groups.

analysis.workSummary: 从高阶Lie algebroid的分次向量丛连接构造Riemann–Hilbert A∞函子、高阶平行移动及holonomy。
analysis.breakthrough: 平坦对象上得到同伦表示间的函子，并在普通Lie algebroid情形恢复既有构造；高阶holonomy携带增广单纯Lie群结构。
analysis.limitations: 依赖文中高阶连接与同伦群胚的范畴设定。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者明确声明整个项目未使用LLM。第28、43页Astra候选来自a straightforward的数学英语。全文常规及拆行补检没有作者实际使用生成式AI的正面披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 为高阶连接提供整体输运和holonomy的统一框架。
